newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada raw materials prices rise 1.3 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Canada raw materials prices rise 1.3 pct in Dec.

text.p: Statistics Canada on Wednesday issued the following economic indicators for December, base 1986=100.
INDEX Month pct Yr pct Dec index

The raw materials price index reflects the prices paid by manufacturers for key raw materials. Unlike the industrial product price index, the raw materials price index includes goods that are not produced in Canada.
A Reuters survey of economists had forecast that the overall index would rise 1.5 percent from December.
(For more information, contact Statistics Canada's Client Services Unit, Prices Division at (613) 951-3350.)
